name: Daiyu
description: "A Dream of Red Mansions" is an epic work that shows the beauty of women and various aspects of ancient Chinese society from all angles, and has successfully created many classic characters who are well-known to every household. Pinku used "Twelve Hairpins" as its design inspiration. In the form of a fan and a hairpin, Pinku freezes the moving moments of the twelve beauties on the gorgeous round fan, outlining a picture of the Red Mansion full of humanistic sentiments. The Daiyu Tuanfan reproduces the romance of Daiyu burying flowers with beautiful colors, lifelike characters and scenes.
